meta.name: add-dial-tool
meta.description: Give chosen NanoClaw agents a real phone number as a container tool — the `dial` CLI baked into the agent image plus OneCLI credential injection for api.getdial.ai, scoped per agent, so the agents you pick can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes from inside the sandbox. Independent of the Dial channel; idempotent; re-run to change which agents may use it. Use when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel.

copy.tagline: 给选中的代理配上真实电话号码，就能从聊天里发短信、打电话、收验证码。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让你手下的代理能直接发短信、打电话或接收验证码。
copy.tagline_en: Give chosen agents a phone number for SMS, calls, and verification codes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage agents that need to text, call, or receive verification codes.

howto.what: 装上后,你就能让 Claude 给你指定的代理开通打电话、发短信的权限:被选中的代理可以对外发短信、打语音电话、收验证码;没被选中的会被拦截。可重复运行来调整授权范围。
howto.when: 当你想让代理能发短信、打电话或运行 `dial` 命令,且不想把 Dial 接成消息通道时触发。

say.text: 让代理 `ag-web` 能发短信和打电话。
say.note: 会运行 add-dial-tool 并为该代理授权。

say.text: 给所有代理都开通 Dial。
say.note: 选择 all,全部获得拨号权限。

say.text: 把 `ag-test` 的 Dial 关掉,只留 `ag-prod`。
say.note: 重新运行技能,更新授权名单。

howto.what_en: Lets Claude give chosen agents real phone capabilities — they can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes; unchosen agents are blocked with 403. Re-running updates the list.
howto.when_en: Fires when you want agents to text, call, or run `dial`, and you don't want Dial wired as a messaging channel.

say_en.text: Let agent `ag-web` send texts and make calls.
say_en.note: Runs add-dial-tool and enables it for that agent.
Selects all, giving everyone dial access.

say_en.text: Disable Dial for `ag-test`, keep it only for `ag-prod`.
say_en.note: Re-runs the skill and updates the allow-list.
